segments: "The heart of Nix configuration: finding the right merge point in a complex hierarchy."

An ordinary attribute set does not add its own attributes to the lexical scope. To reference attributes by name from within the set, use rec or define shared bindings in a let expression first. If an outer variable has the same name, an ordinary attribute set references that outer variable.
This is merging at the Nix language level.
Note: // performs a shallow merge. If both sets contain nested sets with the same name, the latter replaces the former outright.
In NixOS configuration files, we rarely use // directly. The NixOS module system merges configuration for us:
Use dotted paths to define deeply nested attributes directly and reduce nesting.
Use ${...} to generate attribute names dynamically.
